name: calc_correlation
description:
Pearson correlation of two numeric series (population formulas); the longer series is cut to the length of the shorter. Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {correlation, data_points}: correlation from -1 to 1 (6 decimals; 0 if either series is constant).
Inputs (* required): series_x*, series_y* (arrays of numbers, aligned by position).
For the sensitivity of a stock to the market use calc_beta.
Example: {"series_x": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], "series_y": [2, 4, 5, 4, 5]}

series_y.description: Second numeric series, aligned by position
